habitat: Singly or in small coveys in bushveld, woodland and fallow agricultural land, usually not far from water. The male calls from a low branch or an anthill.
summary: A common resident. Entirely dark brown, with red facial skin and a red neck. The colour key says dark grey legs. The description says it is the only red-necked francolin with black legs and a black bill, which disagrees with those dark grey legs, so the bill colour is not stored. The call is a harsh krrraaak-krrraaak-krrraaak, fading at the end. The Kemp code RB was left unchanged.

similar.note: Red-necked Spurfowl has a red bill, a red throat and red legs. Swainson’s Spurfowl is uniformly dark brown.

research.note: Newman calls it a common resident, so status is resident and all twelve months are listed. The colour key says dark grey legs and the description says black legs and a black bill, so the leg and bill colours are not stored as tokens. That is why this needs review. Population figures and the Kemp code RB were left unchanged.
